title: Repeat counted steps
summary: MATLAB: Repeat counted steps. Count up to 4.
introduction: A for loop visits each value in the row after the equals sign.

blocks.text: Use MATLAB. Paste one example into the Command Window, or save it as a .m script and run the script. A MATLAB licence may be required.
The range gives n the values 1, 2 and 3. Each iteration calls fprintf.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The loop variable changes each time; do not reset it inside.
